passage:
A family's flight was cancelled because of a storm. Many passengers became angry at the airport workers.
A pilot who was waiting nearby spoke calmly to a group of travelers. He explained that storms can change quickly and that flying through unsafe weather is not worth arriving on time.
The family still had to wait until the next day. They missed one day of vacation, but they arrived safely.
The daughter wrote in her travel journal: "Delay feels like loss when you are waiting, but safety is invisible when everything goes right."
The cancelled flight became her first lesson of the trip. Not all good decisions feel good at the moment they are made.
